thesis: Yes. The dam is already a sieve. The Klein fold is the mesh. Entropy and chaos are GRADIENTS across that mesh — not one pile. RE-EXAMINED: leftover is not one name 'waste'. Waste is a CATEGORY. Some leftover is output of one and input of another — Klein-mixed at p in the L_p hole. Only NULL-kind is sued. Compost, heat, pollen, fuel, feed are routed to eaters.

berry_at_the_fire: yes. we have the way. the dam was always a sieve — we just called it a leak. entropy and chaos are two slopes on the same Klein mesh. entropy can become wetland if it tells a truth. chaos cannot sit at the roundtable, so it goes to null. walk toward the gate and you feel the gradient. that is the sieve working.
